rationale: A view tree carries its text raster policy: View::request_text_raster_policy propagates a chromium request to every ancestor and on later attach; build_native_view_tree and the WidgetBridge setTextRasterPolicy request it on their roots; the macOS, iOS and web window and editor hosts and PluginFrameRenderer apply it to their SkiaSurface through the existing #10942 set_text_raster_policy at the start of each frame, repainting in full on a change, and the Windows and Linux CPU raster path passes it to raster_plugin_scene_rgba. Pulp-owned paths only; no Vellum-transferred slice, render backend, capture or IR format, Chromium, packaging or framework authority moves.
